final_answer:
**Amazon's total revenue (net sales) for fiscal year 2024 was $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion).**

Supporting detail:
- The figure comes from Amazon.com, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (accession 0001018724-25-000004) [DOC-1].
- Consolidated Statements of Operations: "Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959" (in millions) [DOC-1].

Comparability note: No comparability issues apply here — this is a single-period figure drawn directly from the filing's audited consolidated statements of operations, reported on the same basis as the prior-year comparatives disclosed in the same filing (FY2023: $574,785 million; FY2022: $513,983 million) [DOC-1]. For context, this implies approximately 11.0% year-over-year growth versus FY2023, though the excerpt does not state a growth rate or indicate whether it is reported on a constant-currency basis.

ANSWER: $637,959 million (≈$638.0 billion)
